universal_value.unresolved: Sources do not settle this field. Permitted in every field. The open question must be stated in the record.

f1_position.label: Position
f1_position.question: What did the system's output do, structurally, in the chain of action?

values.retrieve: Returned matching records from a store in response to a query
values.flag: Surfaced an item for human attention
values.filter: Removed or suppressed items before a human saw them
values.decide: Produced an outcome applied without human review

f2_discretion.label: Discretion
f2_discretion.question: What did the system do to the judgment of the person holding power over the subject?

values.expanded: Gave a human confidence or cover to act in a way they could not otherwise have justified
values.checked: Constrained or audited a human decision
values.replaced: Substituted for a decision previously made by a person

f2_discretion.test: Would the human's action have survived review on the non-AI evidence alone? If no, and the action was taken, code expanded.

values.irreversible: No later correction restores the subject's position

values.subject: The person the system operated on, in a relationship with the deployer
values.third party: The person the system operated on, with no relationship to the deployer

values.informed: Bearer knew the system operated on them and could contest before effect
values.unaware: Bearer had no notice or no mechanism to contest

f4_failure_mode.label: Failure mode

values.inference chain: Outputs accurate; the chain of inference built on them was not
values.routing: Output reached the wrong party, or failed to reach the right one
values.taxonomy gap: Harm outside the categories the system recognised
values.absence: Harm occurred because no system was watching where one was available, affordable and effective

absence_threshold: Capability technically available at the time
Low cost relative to the harm

values.no cause of action: No recognised claim covers this harm
values.element missing: A claim exists but fails at a named element — the element must be named in the record
values.immunity: A defendant is shielded (qualified, sovereign, statutory)
values.not a state actor: Private defendant outside a public-law remedy
values.no defect: Product performed as designed, defeating product liability
values.no private right: Statute governs the conduct but creates no private enforcement
values.no detection: Harm structurally undiscoverable by the person harmed
values.preemption: Higher jurisdiction has displaced the applicable rule

values.deployment rule: Use policy or statute governing how output may be acted on
values.liability allocation: Statute assigning responsibility between developer and deployer
values.disclosure: Notice to subjects, or published failure analysis
values.enforcement authority: Granting a regulator or AG power to act

model_performed_as_designed.label: Model performed as designed
model_performed_as_designed.note: True where no component malfunctioned and harm occurred anyway. The distribution of this flag across the dataset is the project's central empirical claim.

values.2: Sworn testimony, regulatory findings, official investigative reports
values.3: Contemporaneous reporting by multiple independent outlets

values.provisional: Coded at tier 2 or 3; records request outstanding
